title: ChunkAct: Action Chunking for Agentic Robotics
abstract: arXiv:2610.18874v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic robotics places a large language model (LLM) agent in the robot control loop, where it composes perception, motion, and vision-language-action (VLA) tools under the guidance of a memory and thereby generalizes to new tasks without retraining. This generality comes at a steep price in efficiency. Every primitive requires a round of LLM reasoning over the full interaction history, so the cost of an episode grows with the number of primitives. We find this reasoning largely redundant: once a sub-goal is chosen, its primitives follow a routine already prescribed by memory. We present ChunkAct, which introduces action chunking to agentic robotics. Online, a single call launches a chunk of chained primitives, which executes autonomously and returns control only upon failure. translated_title: ChunkAct：面向智能体机器人的动作分块方法
translated_abstract: 智能体机器人将大语言模型（LLM）智能体置于机器人控制回路中，它在记忆的指导下组合感知、运动以及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）工具，从而无需重新训练即可泛化到新任务。然而这种通用性以高昂的效率代价为前提：每个基元动作都需要 LLM 对完整交互历史进行一轮推理，因此一个回合的成本会随基元数量的增加而增长。我们发现这种推理在很大程度上是冗余的：一旦子目标被确定，其基元动作就会遵循记忆中已经规定好的例程序列。我们提出 ChunkAct，将动作分块引入智能体机器人技术。在线阶段，一次调用即可启动一串链式基元动作块，该动作块自主执行，仅在失败时才交还控制权。离线阶段，ChunkAct 将记忆编译为这些动作块，使得测试时的执行无需依赖记忆，而规划器则被保留用于需要推理的决策。
tldr: ChunkAct 将动作分块引入智能体机器人，通过离线把记忆编译为链式基元动作块、在线一次调用即可自主执行整块动作（仅在失败时交还控制权），从而消除了每个基元动作都需 LLM 推理的冗余开销，大幅提升效率。
en_tdlr: ChunkAct introduces action chunking to agentic robotics by compiling memory offline into chunks of chained primitives that execute autonomously from a single call—returning control only upon failure—thereby eliminating the largely redundant per-primitive LLM reasoning overhead.
